attributes.context: The provision appears in Section 209, Employees Under Instruction, which also provides flat-rate travel time pay for employees required to go to the Instruction School on their own time.

extraction_text: All employees who have passed the probationary period shall, when learning different equipment or routes other than those routes on which they have been broken in, be paid at their regular rate while doing so.

attributes.context: This text appears in a Side Letter of Clarification between Local 589, Amalgamated Transit Union and Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority, signed by the union president and MBTA general manager, and specifically concerns MBTA's installation of automatic fare collection machines.

extraction_text: The parties hereby agree and acknowledge that in the event the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority installs automatic fare collection machines, employees in the Collectors classification at the time of automation will have their pay and positions protected.

attributes.context: The provision appears in section 511, Carhouse Employees.

extraction_text: Carhouse employees who are displaced as a result of conversion from electrically-powered vehicles to gasoline-powered vehicles shall be considered for employment, to the extent that it is feasible, in any related expansion of the group of employees who do the work on the gas-powered vehicles which corresponds to the work said employees have been performing on electrically-powered vehicles.
